videos.title: Welcome to Tea Break with Manoj: Funny True History
videos.description:
Hello friends, I'm Manoj, and welcome to Tea Break with Manoj.

Funny true stories from history, told in the time it takes to drink a cup of tea. Every story is real and told in simple English, and the sources are always in the description, so you can check every word.

A new story every Saturday, and Shorts on Monday and Wednesday. Grab your tea and subscribe.

The voice in this video is an AI copy of my own voice. The pictures are made with an AI image model (Qwen-Image), and the music is original.
